formation.explanation: A RawNode proposal synchronously enters Step; Node serializes the same proposal in node.run and returns the Step result. Followers forward or drop, candidates drop, and leaders reject removal/transfer/quota cases. Accepted entries acquire current term and next indexes, enter unstable log and are sent with predecessor identity. Follower maybeAppend matches that predecessor, refuses committed conflicts and bounds its new commit by the accepted extent; send defers its response until storage completion. The leader raises peer Match monotonically, computes majority support over active voters (both halves in joint state), and advances only at a matching current-term entry. Its own fresh support is likewise delayed by self MsgAppResp. Commitment propagates through appends and heartbeats capped at peer Match. Ready exposes committed entries; async mode waits for local stable extent, while synchronous mode relies on Ready handling order before Advance. Proposal return does not assert application or client completion.

context.explanation: Ticks or Campaign enter hup only when own progress is eligible, no snapshot is pending and no committed configuration change remains unapplied. Pre-vote leaves term/vote unchanged; real candidacy raises term and sends log-freshness-qualified votes to voter union, including storage-delayed self support. Matching response types and configured voter majorities decide election. Higher ordinary terms adopt follower state; same-term leader contact displaces candidates, stale replies are filtered, and CheckQuorum may relinquish leadership without a term change. Transfer suspends proposals until target catch-up/TimeoutNow or timeout. ApplyConfChange changes quorum and eligibility using simple/joint checks; outgoing voters remain until LeaveJoint. Restart reconstructs HardState and ConfState from Storage, and snapshots can replace suffix/configuration or fast-forward an already matching prefix.

connection.explanation: Authority transitions rebuild progress and vote tracking but preserve established committed log state. Delayed ordinary support from older terms is excluded; newly appended self support is not admitted until append completion. Stabilization requires both the response protocol term and matching unstable entry identity; snapshot completion survives stale protocol terms but clears only its matching pending snapshot. Application responses have zero term and continue advancing already committed work. Pending readOnly acknowledgments reset on role reset, while pre-current-term-commit read requests remain buffered and require a later current-term commit plus configured read protocol. Configuration application can reinterpret existing Match values and recompute commit. Unapplied committed configuration and pending snapshot barriers tie recovery/application to eligibility for the next authority context. These sourced mechanisms establish a usable investigation backbone, not proof that every history respects their intended meaning.

Accepted entries acquire current term and next indexes, enter unstable log and are sent with predecessor identity. Matching response types and configured voter majorities decide election. Higher ordinary terms adopt follower state; same-term leader contact displaces candidates, stale replies are filtered, and CheckQuorum may relinquish leadership without a term change. Transfer suspends proposals until target catch-up/TimeoutNow or timeout. ApplyConfChange changes quorum and eligibility using simple/joint checks; outgoing voters remain until LeaveJoint. Stabilization requires both the response protocol term and matching unstable entry identity; snapshot completion survives stale protocol terms but clears only its matching pending snapshot. Application responses have zero term and continue advancing already committed work. Pending readOnly acknowledgments reset on role reset, while pre-current-term-commit read requests remain buffered and require a later current-term commit plus configured read protocol. Configuration application can reinterpret existing Match values and recompute commit. Unapplied committed configuration and pending snapshot barriers tie recovery/application to eligibility for the next authority context.
